question: Should OpenClaw adopt this quick/full selectable PR template workflow as the supported contributor path?
rationale: The patch is technically focused and compatible with the current PR-context gate, but it changes the repository's contributor authoring contract and needs maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Approve the selectable templates
options.body: Land this PR after normal maintainer review because it solves the linked contributor-friction request while preserving the current authored problem/evidence requirements.

options.title: Narrow the quick template first
options.body: Ask for specific quick-template wording or required sections before merge if maintainers want stronger evidence or impact prompts for all PRs.

options.title: Decline the workflow split
options.body: Close this PR and the linked request if maintainers prefer one fallback template instead of multiple selectable templates.
